The per_entity.inventory_y_rotation entries that used to live here were dead - BlockEntityLoader never propagated per_entity overrides to Block.Entity, and the actual 180-degree yaw bake happens in SourceDiscovery.ID_TO_INVENTORY_Y_ROTATION at tooling time (read by BlockModelConverter and folded into the cube elements before block_entities.json is written). The remaining entry below carries the single tz=1.25 inventory_transform delta on skull_dragon_head that originates in DragonHeadModel.createHeadLayer rather than SkullBlockRenderer; ToolingBlockEntities.mergeInventoryTransformOverrides merges it onto the bytecode-decomposed map. Pattern-derived per-block fields (iconRotation on beds, additive on bells, tint on banners) are now emitted by the tooling directly into block_entities.json - no per_block entries remain here.
